name: Ginger

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, may increase Pitta

folk_wisdom: Traditionally used in many cultures as a warming digestive support.

rituals.title: Warming Ginger Infusion
rituals.description: Traditionally used to warm the body and support digestion.
rituals.instructions: Steep 3-5 thin slices of fresh ginger in hot water for 10 minutes.

name: Peppermint

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic), especially cooling for Pitta

folk_wisdom: Known for its refreshing aroma and traditional use in soothing digestive discomfort.
safety_notes: Avoid if you have severe acid reflux.

rituals.title: Refreshing Temple Ritual
rituals.description: Combine the scent of peppermint with gentle pressure for a mid-day refresh.
rituals.instructions: Inhale the scent of fresh peppermint while gently massaging the temples in circular motions.

name: Turmeric

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Kapha, may increase Vata and Pitta if used in excess

folk_wisdom: A cornerstone of Ayurvedic wellness, traditionally used for vitality and joint comfort.

rituals.title: Golden Milk Ritual
rituals.description: A traditional evening ritual for grounding and vitality.
rituals.instructions: Whisk 1/2 tsp turmeric into 1 cup of warm plant-based milk with a pinch of black pepper.

name: Chamomile
folk_wisdom: One of the most beloved herbs in European folk tradition for evening relaxation.
safety_notes: Avoid if you have a known allergy to ragweed or the Asteraceae family.

rituals.title: Starlight Steep
rituals.description: A gentle ritual to signal the transition to rest.
rituals.instructions: Steep 1 tbsp of dried chamomile flowers in hot water for 5 minutes before bed.

name: Cinnamon

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: Traditionally associated with warmth, abundance, and digestive fire.
safety_notes: Cassia cinnamon contains coumarin; Ceylon (true) cinnamon is preferred for regular use.

rituals.title: Solar Vitality Brew
rituals.description: Cinnamon is ruled by the Sun and is traditionally used to support inner warmth.
rituals.instructions: Add a cinnamon stick to your morning tea or coffee to invite solar energy into your day.
